sentences.text: Farber lipogranulomatosis and spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy are both linked to the gene ASAH1 in curated databases [e_46330a802f74] [e_71f9e31c0e45].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_5c34bdd1fa29].
For Farber lipogranulomatosis, lumps under the skin near the joints are a curated, very frequent feature [e_ed3a3e977216].
A sideways bend of the wrist toward the little finger is an observed feature, based on 1 of 1 in the record [e_af10a9282f7c].
For the spinal muscular atrophy syndrome, a research grant is listed for preparing a gene therapy [e_cf46ced35bdb].
That grant has a low confidence of 0.5 and shows planned research, not a treatment that exists [e_cf46ced35bdb].
These edges list no symptoms for the spinal muscular atrophy syndrome [e_71f9e31c0e45].
